fusions.name: Skitter Shot
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gnawing Run
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 10 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Behind the Skirting
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Dusk Scurry
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
